subject: sounds
title: Letter sounds
about: Hear a word, pick the letter that makes its first sound. This is the Kindergarten code his class re-checks in the first weeks of CKLA Unit 1, and it is the letter-sound knowledge DIBELS NWF scores.
tip: Say the word slowly and stretch the first sound before he taps.

cards.q: Which letter makes the first sound in pig?
cards.note: p is the first sound in pig, pen and pot.

cards.q: Which letter makes the first sound in tent?
cards.note: t is the first sound in tent, top and tub.
